import pandas as pd

df = pd.read_excel('fhwa_motor_vehicle_registrations_2022.xlsx', sheet_name='CY MV-1 Publish', header=None)
# Column A is state (index 0), Column F is Publicly Owned Buses (index 5)

import pandas as pd

df = pd.read_excel('fhwa_motor_vehicle_registrations_2022.xlsx', sheet_name='CY MV-1 Publish', header=None)
# States are rows 9 to 59 (0-indexed)
data = df.iloc[9:60].copy()
# Clean state name (column 0) and total motor vehicles (column 15 / P)
data['clean_state'] = data[0].astype(str).str.replace(r'\s*\(\d+\)', '', regex=True).str.strip()
data['total_mv'] = pd.to_numeric(data[15])
top3 = data.sort_values(by='total_mv', ascending=False).head(3)
result = top3[0].tolist()

import pandas as pd

df = pd.read_excel('fhwa_motor_vehicle_registrations_2022.xlsx', sheet_name='CY MV-1 Publish', header=None)
# Column J is Total Trucks (index 9)
mi = df[df[0].astype(str).str.startswith('Michigan')].iloc[0]
pa = df[df[0].astype(str).str.startswith('Pennsylvania')].iloc[0]
result = pa[0] if float(pa[9]) > float(mi[9]) else mi[0]

import pandas as pd

import pandas as pd

df = pd.read_excel('fhwa_motor_vehicle_registrations_2022.xlsx', sheet_name='CY MV-1 Publish', header=None)

fl = float(df[df[0].astype(str).str.startswith('Florida')].iloc[0][1])
tx = float(df[df[0].astype(str).str.startswith('Texas')].iloc[0][1])

import pandas as pd

df = pd.read_excel('fhwa_motor_vehicle_registrations_2022.xlsx', sheet_name='CY MV-1 Publish', header=None)
ne_states = ['Connecticut', 'Maine', 'Massachusetts', 'New Hampshire', 'Rhode Island', 'Vermont']
data = df.iloc[9:60].copy()
data['clean_state'] = data[0].astype(str).str.replace(r'\s*\(\d+\)', '', regex=True).str.strip()
ne_df = data[data['clean_state'].isin(ne_states)]
# Column M is Total Motorcycles (index 12)
result = int(pd.to_numeric(ne_df[12]).sum())
